text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Medusa and her friends have put a stop to Kanon's latest rebellion. What is Medusa thinking now that she has gained a new kin, Medusiana?
text_block_list.orig_text:
カノンの叛逆を制圧したメドゥーサたち。
新たな眷属『メドゥシアナ』を得たメドゥーサは、
果たして何を思う──

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Well then. What are you going to do next, Medusa?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
これからどうするつもりだ？　
メドゥーサ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: What I'm going to do remains the same. I'm going to find my sisters. Kanon didn't know anything, so I'll have to start all over again... but it'll be okay.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシのやることは変わらないわ。
お姉ちゃんたちを見つける。
カノンのヤツは何も知らなかったから、
また一からやり直しだけど……
でも大丈夫。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Now... I'm not alone anymore. I have a reassuring new familiar and also... friends...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシはもう、
一人じゃないから。
心強い眷属と、
あと……
友達も、
いるから……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: What's that? I didn't hear you very well at the end there. Could you say it a little louder?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ？　
最後良く聞こえなかったぞ？
もっと大きな声で言ってくれるか？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: I-It's nothing! ...Anyway, the key here is Nephy Nella. I'll meet her, and if necessary, I'll defeat her. If I do that, I'm sure...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんでもないっての！　
……ともかく、
カギはネフィ＝ネラよ。
アイツに会って、
そして必要とあらば──
倒すわ。
そうすれば、
きっと……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Medusa... Both I and this guy will help you if you search for your sisters. So, when that time comes, please don't hesitate to ask for our help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
メドゥーサ……
あたしもこいつも、
お姉さんたちを捜すなら
手伝うわ。
だから、
その時は
遠慮なく頼ってね。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Saren. ...Well then, I'll be heading back to Gio Gehenna. But first I need to win the real Snake Festival so that I can speak to Nephy Nella face to face...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがと、
サレン。
……それじゃあアタシ、
ジオ・ゲヘナへ戻るわ。
まずは本物の蛇祭りで優勝して
ネフィ＝ネラの首根っこを掴んでやらなくちゃ──

text_block_list.text: ...No. There is no need for you to do that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──否。
その必要は御座んせん。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...!? That voice, it can’t be... Nephy Nella! Furthermore, the one she's grabbing by her neck with her iron slime is... Kanon!? Where did she even pick her up!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
！？　
その声、
まさか……
ネフィ＝ネラ！
それに
鉄のスライムで首根っこ掴んでるの、
カノンじゃない！？
どこで拾ったのよ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Korokorokorokoro. I will echo an evaluation I made earlier, Landosol truly is a delightful place. Not only does the sky bring rain and arrows, but even fools who caused an uproar fall down from the sky.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロコロコロ。
ランドソルとは、
ほんに愉快な地である事よ。
空より雨や矢のみならず、
騒動の元の痴れ者まで降り来たるとは。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Come on, you sleepyhead. Just how long is this dream of yours going to last?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ、
虚け。
一体何時まで
夢現である也？

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Ouch?! Wait. N-N-N-N-N-NEPHY NELLA! M-My, what a coincidence. Why are you here...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいたぁっ！？
って──
ネ、
ネネネネフィ＝ネラ！
ア、
アアアナタ
どうしてここに……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Those words... I should be the one echoing them to you. Local gossip has flown to my ears like the wind. A fool, intoxicated by an happy atmosphere, declared that she'd do whatever she wants on the homeplace of another country.
text_block_list.orig_text:
其の言葉、
そっくり其の儘返しんす。
風の噂に耳にせん──
目出度き空気に酔った痴れ者が、
余所様の膝元にて
好き放題と喃。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: O-O-O-O-Oh my... I-I-I-I-I-I-I-Is that so? Geez, there truly are some crazy individuals out there nowadays~
text_block_list.orig_text:
まままぁ～
そそ
そうなんですのぉ～？
まったくぅ、
とぉんでもねぇヤツも
いたもんですわねぇ～

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. You truly think yourself a wise woman, don't you? If you dare challenge my position as Princess Gio Gehenna so badly, I will accept -- Frankly, I cannot overlook a plot to take the home of a friend from another country.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
汝も懲りん娘でありんすな。
ジオ・ゲヘナの媛の座に堂々挑むならば
受けて立とうとも──
異世界の朋友の首を掻かんとする企て、
断じて見過ごすこと能わず。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: EEEEEEEEEEEeeekkkk...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひい
いいっ……！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Lord Knight. And everyone else. I will take responsibility for Kanon's actions and punish her accordingly, so please leave it to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿。
それに皆様方。
カノン奴は、
責任持って
こってり仕置き致しまする故、
どうかわっちに委ねて頂きたく候。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Medusa. You've grown into quite the fine young lady while I wasn't watching... My, it hurts to be looked at so energetically. You'll end up petrifying my soft skin.
text_block_list.orig_text:
メドゥーサや。
些と見ぬ内に、
随分立派に成った喃──
……これ、
斯様に目力を籠めるで無し。
わっちの柔肌が、
カチリコチリと石化してしまうでな。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: SHUT UP! Give them back, my territory... and my sisters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるさい！　
返してよ、
アタシの財産も……
お姉ちゃんも！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: I don't mind in the slightest, Lord Knight. Those crimes are all mine to bear. Medusa - you are right. The fortune of the "Gorgon" family, as well as the throne of the "Snake", are all in my hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
構いませぬ也、
騎士殿や。
件の咎、
全てわっちにあり申す。
メドゥーサ──
汝の言うとおり。
ゴルゴーン家の財産、
並びに『蛇』の座は、
すべてわっちの手中に有る也。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: You damn...! How dare you speak so branzely! I'll settle this right now--
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつ、
よくもぬけぬけと……！
今すぐケリをつけてあげるんだからっ──

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: W-Wait! Calm down, Medusa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
待て！
冷静になるのだメドゥーサ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't stop me, Monika!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと！
止めないでよモニカ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Don't you get it already? As you are right now, you're no match for her in the slightest. Besides...
text_block_list.orig_text:
分からないのか？
今のお主では、
到底敵う相手ではあるまい。
それに──

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: ...That look in Lady Nephy Nella's eyes. It's like that of a loving mother. Just like how Saren watches over the children back at her Orphanage...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ネフィ＝ネラ殿のあの眼差し。
まるで慈母のそれではないか。
救護院の子らに対するサレンのような……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: H-How did I get dragged into this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あたしは関係なくない？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: I offer my thanks for your helpful mediation, Lady Monika. ...Medusa, please sit down and listen first. If you wish to fight after that, we'll still be in time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仲立ち感謝致しまする、
モニカ殿。
……メドゥーサや、
先ずは座して聞きなんし。
戦うのはその後でも
遅く無かろうて。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: After your sisters, Stheno and Euryale, disappeared, I used all means at my disposal to seize the Gorgon family's assets, including lands, mansions, and treasures.
text_block_list.orig_text:
汝の姉君、
ステンノとエウリュアレーが行方を眩ませた後。
わっちは有りと有らゆる手段を用い
土地や屋敷、
財宝など、
ゴルゴーン家の財産を掌握して候。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: But such an act... perhaps, could it have been to prevent other invaders to lay claim to their fortune?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
それって、
もしかして、
他の人たちに
財産を
奪わせないようにするため……
でしょうか？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Kokorokorokoro... How shrewd of you, Lady elf from the Orphanage. Indeed. There are many nobles and nefarious organizations running rampant in my Gio Gehenna...
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロコロコロ……
聡いことでありんすな、
森精の淑女殿。
いかにも。
ジオ・ゲヘナには
数多の貴族や
よからぬ組織が
跳梁跋扈しておりますれば。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: The Gorgon sisters ran a very efficient and good government. Such a thing is rare indeed in my Gio Gehenna... However, with the rulers of said government absent, the fruit of their good work would've been quickly replaced by the hands of a villain.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴルゴーン姉妹は、
実に善き政を布いて候。
其れはジオ・ゲヘナにあって
全く稀有なもの……
然れど
領主が不在とあらば、
善政の実りは忽ち
悪漢の餌へと挿げ替わる也。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: I see. So before such a thing were to happen, you, Lady Nephy Nella, avoided that such cunning villains would be able to get their hands on their territory so easily.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
そうなる前に
ネフィ＝ネラ殿が押さえてしまえば
ずる賢い奴らも
簡単には手出しできなくなる、
というわけか。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: I'll gladly accept your slander of being branded as an invader. Compared to the misfortune of innocent children being brought to tears, the stigma against my reputation is nothing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
侵略者との誹りなど、
甘んじて受けましょうぞ。
罪なき幼子らが
泣くような目に遭う不幸に比べれば、
わっちの汚名など
如何程の痛痒でもありんせん。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Nephy-Nella, from what I've been able to grasp, I believe we'd grow to be steadfast friends... Wait, maybe I was rude to a proper Princess just a second ago, wasn't I? Oh dear.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ネフィ＝ネラさん、
ちょっと
仲良くなれそうだわ……
って、
プリンセス相手に失礼だったわね。
あたしったら。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Th-That can't be... Then... Does that mean that I've been under your protection all this time, Nephy Nella?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな……
じゃあ、
アタシはずっと
ネフィ＝ネラに守られてた、
ってこと……？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Th-That has to be a lie... Then, where are my sisters...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなのウソよ……
じゃあ、
お姉ちゃんたちの行方は……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: My spies haven't been able to find even a mere lead on the two of them. Even after the commotion that the Spider caused and the damage to the Gorgon's territory, hey still won't show their faces... I have no choice but to assume that they're no longer in Gio Gehenna.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっちの間者からは、
何一つ便り無し。
蜘蛛の騒ぎにて
ゴルゴーンの領土も痛手を被れど、
尚も顔を出さぬ
ということは……
最早ジオ・ゲヘナには居らぬと見る他あるまいて。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...I understand the situation. But to be honest, I still can't trust you from the bottom of my heart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……事情は分かった。
それでも、
正直、
まだアンタのことは
心からは信じられない。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: However... if it's {0}, I can trust him a little. If he trusts you, then I'll do the same. So that works for me... for now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
こいつのことなら
ちょっとは信じられる。
こいつがアンタのことを信じてるなら、
アタシもそうする。
だから今は
それでいいわ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Very well, very well indeed. ...My Lord Knight. Although Medusa is a gifted young lady, she is currently no more than a young chick with a green rump. I am well aware that this will be a lot of trouble to ask for, but I would love if you were to take care of her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
善哉、
善哉。
──騎士殿や。
メドゥーサ奴は
天稟有れど、
今は尻の青い雛同然の有様。
御面倒は重々承知でありんすが、
何卒宜しくお頼み申し上げ奉る。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't treat me like a kid! No, I mean, actually I'm a snake, not a chicken!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと！　
子ども扱いしないでよ！
ていうか
アタシはヒヨコじゃなくて蛇なんだから！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Kokorokorokoro. To me, both you and Lord Knight here are adorable little children.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロコロコロ、
わっちにすれば
汝も騎士殿たちも
普く愛らしい稚児にありんす。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Oh. More importantly, Medusa. You will not be able to return to Gio Gehenna for a while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
と。
其れよりもメドゥーサよ。
汝は暫く、
ジオ・ゲヘナへ戻るを能わず。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: She won't be able to return...? You mean you're going to banish her?
text_block_list.orig_text:
戻るを能わずって……
出禁にしちゃうってこと？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why?! I didn't do anything wrong here! ...Oh boy, oh boy! I knew that you're not to be trusted!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ！？　
なんでよ！　
アタシなにも悪いことしてないんだけど！
おーぼーよ、
おーぼー！　
やっぱりこいつは
倒さなきゃダメよ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Do not panic. As I said before, your sisters - Stheno and Euryale - are probably not in Gio Gehenna. Therefore, you will have to seek their shadows, or any track of theirs, in the outside world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
慌てるで無し。
先に述べた通り、
汝の姉──
ステンノとエウリュアレーは、
恐らく
ジオ・ゲヘナには居らぬであろう。
為らば外の世界に
その影を求めるは必定也。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Because your sisters power was so mighty, they might not be able to return from a wall they accidentally crossed--or maybe, they might've made contact with the unexplored underground ruins that beckoned Princess Anne and the others, and were sent to an even more distant land.
text_block_list.orig_text:
強大な存在故、
偶さか踏み越えた壁を戻れずに居るか──
或いは
アン姫らを招いた未解明の地下遺跡の類と接触し、
更なる遠つ国へと飛ばされたやも知れぬ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Hmm, true enough if a Princess of an entire country doing everything she can to find them still can’t even get a hold of either of their trails, then it doesn’t seem like she’s speaking at random.
text_block_list.orig_text:
むう、
たしかに一国の王女が手を尽くしているのに、
尻尾すら掴めないというなら、
あながち間違いではなさそうだ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: B-But that doesn't mean... To be alone in a place like this that I don't know...
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも
だからって……
こんな知らない場所で、
一人でなんて……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Are you saying you're afraid? Because you're a snake that grew up in a cozy environment under the protection of a noble family, the cold air of this other world makes you shiver. In that case, I'll go back on my word and take you back into my "hands".
text_block_list.orig_text:
フム。
怖いと申すか？
名家の庇護でぬくぬく育った蛇ゆえに、
異世界の寒気は身が竦むと。
それならば──
此方も前言翻し、
掌を『どりる』しようというもの。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Very well. You will live peacefully at my side and end your days living in peace. You and Mone may have clashing personalities from what I can see but if you're not planning to bark like a traitor just as Kanon does, and act like a disciplined dog, Mone will raise an eyebrow for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よござんしょ。
わっちの膝元で、
安らかに飼い殺して進ずる。
汝とモネとは折り合い悪かろうが──
カノンの如き逆徒ではなく、
躾の悪い犬として吠えるとあらば、
モネも眉を下すであろう也。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: A-Aaaaah? Are you kidding me? Who are you calling a dog?! I mean, I'm not scared at all! ...Watch me! I'll definitely find my sisters and bring them to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はああぁ？　
ふざっけんじゃないわよ
誰が犬よ！
というか、
怖くなんかないっての！　
……見てなさい！
必ずお姉ちゃんたちを見つけ出して
アンタの前に連れて行くんだから！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: That's the good spirit I wanted to see. I look forward to the day when you and your sisters come together to reclaim your territory.
text_block_list.orig_text:
其の意気や善し。
何れ汝が姉らと共に
領土を奪い返しに来る日を、
楽しみにしておるでな──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: She yearned so much for her older sisters that she was worried about whether or not she'd have been able to win against me, but now that she has been blessed with good friends and learned of a new world, it was nigh time for her to leave the nest. Cheer up and look forward, youngest child of the "Snake".
text_block_list.orig_text:
偉大なる姉に憧れるばかりで、
克己が叶うか懸念であったが──
善き友に恵まれ、
新たな世界を知った今こそ
巣立ちの時。
励みたもれ、
蛇の末子や。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, Nephy Nella took Kanon and returned to Gio Gehenna. Leaving Medusa behind alone--
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうしてネフィ＝ネラはカノンを連れジオ・ゲヘナへと帰還した。
あとにはメドゥーサ一人を残して──

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...That being said, searching for my sisters in such a place where I have no real ties to is going to be pretty tough, even more when I think about it. Ah, maybe that was a bit of a bad move...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──とは言ったものの、
縁もゆかりもない土地でお姉ちゃん捜しって、
よく考えなくても厳しいわよね。
あぁ、
ちょっとマズったかも……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, you're not alone anymore. We'll be there to help you find your sisters. Right, my comrade?
text_block_list.orig_text:
安心しろ、
おまえはもう一人じゃない。
姉上捜しは
我々も手伝わせてもらおう。
なあ、
貴公？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: You can come to my guildhouse to have a place where to live at. It's an orphanage, so there are a lot of children and it's lively, so don't be shy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
住むところはひとまず
うちに来ればいいわ。
救護院だから子どもが多くて賑やかだから、
遠慮はいらないわ。

text_block_list.name: Medusiana
text_block_list.text: Shaaaa!
text_block_list.orig_text: シャアァー！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: You three... and Medusiana too... I-If you insist so much, then I'll welcome your help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタたち……
それに
メドゥシアナも……
そ、
そこまで言うなら、
行ってあげるわ！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Haha, this is how kids should be. For now, all of us, why don't we go back to the Orphanage?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
子どもはこうでなくっちゃ。
とりあえずみんなで
救護院に戻らない？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: I said I was going out with the kids, but now it's this late, so I want to at least give them a fun and lively New Year's time with what's left...
text_block_list.orig_text:
子どもたちに一緒に出掛けるって言ってたのに
こんな時間になっちゃったから、
せめて賑やかに
楽しませてあげたいんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: I guess it can't be helped. I'll be relying on you for a while, so it wouldn't be a bad idea to show a little gratitude.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方ないわね。
しばらくお世話になりそうだし、
軽く恩を売っておくのも悪くないわ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: I find no reason to refuse such an invitation. My comrade, we shall accompany her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
断る理由もあるまい。
貴公、
我々もご相伴にあずかるとしよう。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Monika and her friends visit the Orphanage with Saren and spend a fun time surrounded by children. Then, late into the night, Monika is alone, basking in the night breeze...
text_block_list.orig_text:
サレンと共に救護院を訪れたモニカたちは
子どもたちに囲まれ楽しいひと時を過ごした。
そして夜もすっかり更け、
モニカは一人夜風に当たっていた──

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: *phew*
text_block_list.orig_text: ふぅ……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: A-Amazake, huh? How thoughtful of you. Thank you, I'll have some... Hey, my comrade. There's something I need to apologize for.
text_block_list.orig_text:
む、
甘酒か。
気が利くではないか。
いただこう……
なあ
貴公、
私は一つ
謝らなくてはいけないことがあるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: This New Year's, I've been working behind the scenes to try my best to have you enjoy a peaceful time, if only for this day, without any worries or troubles.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は
此度の正月、
貴公に
なんの憂いも面倒事もなく、
ただ純粋に平和に楽しんでほしい、
そう思い
色々と
手はずを整え
動いてきた。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: But in reality, it ended up causing you even more trouble. If I had been able to take control of Kanon's actions quickly, you wouldn't have had to endure such danger...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが実際は
貴公の手を煩わせる結果になってしまった。
私が早急に
カノンを制圧できていれば、
貴公を危険な目に遭わせることもなかったのに……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: It really scared the hell out of me... You're a great man, being able to laugh about it so easily.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちは大層肝を冷やしたんだがな……
あれを笑い話にできる貴公は、
やはり
器が大きいな。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: ...Hah. That's right, that's just the kind of person you've always been. I'm sure your positivity and friendliness had a positive influence on Medusa in there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はぁ。
そうだな、
貴公はそういうヤツだったな。
そのポジティブさ、
人当たりの良さが
メドゥーサにもいい影響を与えたのだろうな。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: In the end, it seems I misjudged your strength. I still have a long way to go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局のところ、
私は
貴公の強さを見誤っていたようだ。
私もまだまだということだな。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: You two will catch a cold if you stay outside forever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも、
いつまでも外にいたら
風邪ひいちゃうわよ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: That's right, you have no right to be slacking off, so hurry up and come help with the kids!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよ、
いつまでもサボってないで
戻ってガキンチョどもの相手しなさいよー！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Whoops, seems like we have quite the fans calling for us to get back. ...Now that I think about it, I've been busy all this time and haven't had a chance to say a proper New Year's greeting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
お呼びがかかってしまったな。
……そういえば
ずっとバタバタしていて
しっかりと新年の挨拶もできていなかったな。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: True enough. However, everyone's here right now, and look, Medusa, too. So...
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしかに。
丁度みんなそろったことだし、
ほら、
メドゥーサも。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: I guess it can't be helped. Well then~
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方ないわね。
それじゃあ──

text_block_list.name: Medusa Saren Monika
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!
text_block_list.orig_name: メドゥーサ・サレン・モニカ
text_block_list.orig_text:
新年あけまして
おめでとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: And with that, I look forward to working with you again this year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
というわけで、
今年もよろしくね。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: A message from me as well. Thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシからも一応ね。
よろしく頼むわ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Well, now that everything is wrapped up nicely, let's eat, party, and have fun tonight! Our New Year's festivities are just beginning!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ、
いい感じでまとまったところで、
今宵は食べて騒いで
遊び倒すぞ！
我々の正月は
これからだ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: In the end, it turned out to be a normal New Year's holiday, but Monika's heart was filled with joy and new hopes for the days to come
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局いつも通りの正月となってしまったが、
モニカの心はどこまでも晴れやかで、
新たな期待に胸を膨らませるのだった。
